create_kalman_filter_track: create a KalmanFilter instance and initiate a new track from an initial bounding box measurement
run_kalman_filter_prediction: run the Kalman filter prediction step to forecast the next state mean and covariance
run_kalman_filter_correction: run the Kalman filter update step to correct predicted state with a new measurement
project_state_to_measurement: project the Kalman filter state distribution to measurement space for comparison with observations
predict_multiple_states: run the vectorized multi_predict step to forecast states and covariances for multiple tracks at once
